scripts.dev:emulators: pnpm build && node scripts/run-firebase.mjs emulators:start --project demo-tastes --export-on-exit=.firebase-data
scripts.dev:emulators:restore: pnpm build && node scripts/run-firebase.mjs emulators:start --project demo-tastes --import=.firebase-data --export-on-exit=.firebase-data
scripts.reset:ios: xcrun simctl uninstall booted com.vkassin.tastes || true; pnpm mobile:build:ios && pnpm dev:ios
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:frontend:integration && pnpm test:rules && pnpm test:auth
scripts.test:rules: TEST_PROJECT_ID=demo-tastes-test node scripts/run-firebase.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-tastes-test --only firestore,storage "vitest run services/backend/tests/rules"
scripts.test:auth: pnpm build && TEST_PROJECT_ID=demo-tastes-test TEST_FUNCTIONS_HOST=127.0.0.1:5002 node scripts/run-firebase.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-tastes-test --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run services/backend/tests/auth"
scripts.prepush: pnpm build && pnpm format:check "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm audit --prod
